learning_outcomes.text: The purpose of the lesson is to acquire the skills to choose proper methods and strategies for measurement and assessment of measurement errors and uncertainties.
Classifies geometric values in size and shape and defines the method and strategy for measuring them
Can perform measurements basic dimensions geometric and define uncertainty dimensions
aware of the consequences accepting and conducting a survey measurement strategy

syllabus_topics: Calculation/selection of standardized tolerances and deviations
Calculation of gaps and indentations in shaft and hole joints
Measurement of geometrical features – types of measurements
Evaluation and of static and dynamic measurements
Analysis of static and dynamic measurement errors
Classical optimization method (in outline) using Lagrange's differential extremum
Analysis of uncertainty of direct, indirect and complex measurements
Calculation of partial and relative errors

Measurement systems – processing functions (Fourier transform, Laplace transform, transmission coefficient of the system operator, transmission coefficient of individual measuring elements in the system, examples of transformations)
Type A and B uncertainty estimations

assessment_methods.method: Arithmetic mean of scores from submitted reports and possible theory tests (lab exercises)

assessment_rules: The condition for passing the course is to achieve all the required learning outcomes. For the lecture, a written test consists of solving an accounting problem, considering the correctness of the result, calculation method, and independence of work. For lab exercises, the arithmetic mean of scores from all submitted reports and possible theory tests will be taken, and all ratings must be positive.
